title: Tori over arbitrary scheme bases
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A group scheme $T$ over $S$ means a group object in schemes over $S$: multiplication $T\times_ST\to T$, unit $S\to T$ and inverse $T\to T$ obey the group identities. For $r\in\mathbb N$, let $M_{S,r}$ be the group-valued functor on $S$-schemes sending $V\to S$ to $(\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)^\times)^r$, with componentwise multiplication and restrictions induced by pullback of functions. Here a unit is an element with a multiplicative inverse; for $r=0$ this is the trivial group. This is the functor of points of $\mathbf G_{m,S}^r$. The group scheme $T$ is a relative torus if there exist an fppf covering $\{U_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site], finite ranks $r_i\in\mathbb N$, and isomorphisms of group-valued functors $\operatorname{Mor}_S(-,T)|_{\mathit{Sch}/U_i}\cong M_{U_i,r_i}$. Ranks may vary between covering members; no globally constant rank, field base, nonempty base or positive rank is required.
